criteria.name: Evolving Total Peace strategy
criteria.description: Assess how the government balances negotiations with selective coercive pressure, and how shifts between dialogue and military action affect conflict dynamics.

criteria.name: Armed group adaptability
criteria.description: Evaluate how armed groups exploit negotiation periods to expand influence, and how they respond to renewed state pressure by reallocating resources or altering targets.

criteria.name: Ceasefire fragility and compliance
criteria.description: Examine patterns of ceasefire adherence and breakdowns, and their impact on security force confrontations and civilian harm.

criteria.name: Regionalized peace talks impact
criteria.description: Analyze the effectiveness of localized negotiation frameworks in reducing violence, including the role of local authorities and civil society in sustaining de-escalation.

criteria.name: Uneven geographic outcomes
criteria.description: Identify disparities in violence trends across departments and municipalities, noting hotspots where violence persists or escalates despite progress elsewhere.

criteria.name: Non-aggression pacts and spillovers
criteria.description: Consider how local truces between armed actors reduce violence in targeted areas while potentially displacing or concentrating conflict in adjacent regions.

criteria.name: Civilians’ exposure and targeting
criteria.description: Track changes in civilian exposure to conflict and direct targeting, including displacement and confinement patterns linked to territorial disputes.

criteria.name: Illicit economies as drivers
criteria.description: Assess how cocaine production, trafficking routes, and illegal mining sustain competition among armed groups and shape territorial control.

criteria.name: Competition among major actors
criteria.description: Evaluate shifting power balances and territorial contests among principal armed groups, and how these rivalries influence conflict intensity.

criteria.name: Factional splits and internal rifts
criteria.description: Analyze how schisms within armed organizations reshape conflict dynamics, including localized surges in violence and negotiation setbacks.

criteria.name: Cross-border security influences
criteria.description: Examine how security trends and criminal alliances in neighboring countries affect violence levels and trafficking corridors in border departments.

criteria.name: Dependence on external political context
criteria.description: Assess how political developments in neighboring states influence the viability of talks, guarantor roles, and safe havens for armed leadership.

criteria.name: State presence and governance gains
criteria.description: Evaluate whether reduced violence translates into sustained state presence, service delivery, and institutional control in previously contested areas.

criteria.name: Humanitarian trends and protection
criteria.description: Monitor humanitarian indicators—displacement, confinements, access restrictions—and the effectiveness of protection and assistance responses.

criteria.name: Negotiation sequencing and scope
criteria.description: Consider the interplay between local and national negotiations, including risks that regional processes undermine or bolster national-level talks.

criteria.name: Metrics of conflict reduction
criteria.description: Use consistent indicators of conflict events and civilian harm to gauge progress, while accounting for displacement, underreporting, and geographic clustering.

criteria.name: Criminal market fragmentation
criteria.description: Assess whether fragmentation among criminal actors increases volatility and violence, particularly around key trafficking and mining hubs.

criteria.name: Security force posture and outcomes
criteria.description: Analyze the effects of changes in military operations and policing on armed group behavior and on collateral risks to civilians.

criteria.name: Community engagement and legitimacy
criteria.description: Evaluate the role of communities and local leaders in sustaining agreements, building legitimacy, and deterring armed group coercion.

criteria.name: Outlook and scenario risks
criteria.description: Outline plausible trajectories for conflict in the near term, highlighting triggers that could escalate violence or consolidate de-escalation.
